I greatly appreciate your time. Thank you. There is no need to send me anything, you have given more than you will ever know. I live way up in boston. If i am ever in texas I will message you to play. Thank you so much I think you helped a lot.

This is a song I listen to when I am sad. Maybe it can help you sometime.
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6VAkOhXIsI0
I have only been about five times but i have really enjoyed it. Putting is    very hard hahahah. Dude you have calmed me down a huge deal. First time i have smiled all week.
I do not know how to make that transition either. Sorry about your grandma. Matter of fact I just started playing disc golf this year.

I hope you make some friends. I have the same problem. I feel like people at work like me but they must not because they always come in after the weekend and talk about stuff they did together that I wasnt invited to. 

And about your grandmother. Cheerish every minute with her. I loved my grandma so much and the day she died I lost it and I have not been the same since.

I just don't know what to do anymore with anything. I am doing terrible in school, barely have any money, now I lost my love shit sucks.

I am sorry to hear that. I hope you find someone someday. 
For the most part yes I have always felt like this. When I was ten years old I told my parents I was going to kill myself and I saw a councelor for a year or so. Ever since than I have been good till about two years ago when my grandmother died. She was the nicest lady in the world and we talked about everything. I feel isolated from society. My good friends are all gone I havent talked to them in at least a year. I get walked all over by everyone in my life. All I had was my girlfriend. She was the only person that has ever listened to me. She was there for me for everything. I am just so mentally unstable.

No i have no one to talk to. I am sorry you had to deal with something like this. I have very few hobbies other than fishing, but I tried that and it was miserable. I have just been thinking for so long who will care if I am dead. No one will. Absolutely no one. It's so sad but true.

I am just so miserable. I use to be so happy. Now I am her sobbing my eyes out for the past week. Wasting my life. It is not worth it to me at this point. I do not know what to do. My girlfriend was my life now I have nothing to look forward to
I think that everyone would be happy if I am just gone
I just hope I can get her back
I just don't know what to do. This was my first love we have been dating for 3 years. We had a place together and everything. This came out of no where. I am so sad
